description: squirelo/Arduino-JoyCon-Library-for-Nintendo-Switch — Transform your ATmega32u4 based Arduino boards into Nintendo Switch-compatible gamepads! This library enables the Arduino Leonardo, Micro, or compatible clones to be recognized as HID game controllers with customizable inputs. Featuring support for up to 16 buttons, a hat switch, and dual analog sticks with 8-bit precision
